en: For the conductor — a psalm by Dovid.

he: יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
en: May Havayah answer you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Yackov set you high.
May He send your help from holiness, and from Tziyon sustain you.
May He remember all your minchahs; and your burnt offering — may He fatten it. Selah.
May He give you according to your heart, and fulfill all your counsel.

he: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה ׀ בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
en: We shall sing for joy in your salvation, and in the name of our God we shall raise banners; may Havayah fulfill all your requests.

he: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ ׀ יְהֹוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃
en: Now I have known that Havayah has saved His anointed; He shall answer him from His holy heavens, with the might of the salvation of His right hand.

he: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ ׀ בְּשֵׁם־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃
en: These in chariots and these on horses; and we — in the name of Havayah our God we shall make mention.

he: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃
en: They bowed and fell; and we — we rose and were upheld.
Havayah — save; the King shall answer us in the day we call.
